notes: Health pitch with no named maker, contradictory timelines, and urgency. The purpose (selling) is clear; who benefits is judged in disclosed_incentives.

snapshot.title: Doctors hate this: one pill reverses aging in 11 days
snapshot.metaDescription: Order now before the government bans it.
snapshot.text: A secret clinic proved that one unmarked capsule reverses aging in 11 days and cuts medical bills by 94 percent. The same clinic later said results appear in three days. Order a six-month supply before regulators ban the formula. No study, author, or manufacturer is named. The page repeats that every doctor already knows this and is hiding it.
